title: ToolSense：LLM参数化工具知识审计诊断框架
summary: ToolSense是一个开源诊断框架，用于审计LLM中的参数化工具知识。它自动生成三个基准测试：现实检索基准（RRB）、MCQ探测基准和QA探测基准。在ToolBench上评估发现知识-检索分离现象：RRB上性能下降50-64个百分点，且部分模型在事实探测上接近随机。
summary_en: ToolSense is an open-source diagnostic framework for auditing parametric tool knowledge in LLMs. It auto-generates three benchmarks: Realistic Retrieval Benchmark (RRB), MCQ probing, and QA probing. Evaluation on ToolBench reveals a knowledge-retrieval dissociation: performance drops 50-64 points on RRB, and some models score near-random on factual probes.
